prose: TechCrunch reports hardware startup Aina launched a $399 'AI ring' with a screen, joystick, mic and speaker to talk to agents, take notes, set reminders, take calls and control things like Apple TV. Aina raised $5.5M in July and previously made Mirage, a three-key Mac controller whose keys mapped to app actions such as muting in Google Meet. The ring is pitched as a controller for AI and non-AI apps. Notes can also be dictated on a Mac with Wispr Flow.
highlights: $399 ring with screen, joystick, mic and speaker
Talk to agents, take notes, set reminders, take calls
